answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by reserving 1,000 distinct operational slots, treating each reservation as an opal-hardened anchor that prohibits signal sharing. A central verifier monitors these slots by sending a zephyr-swift pulse to measure round-trip latency, ensuring each identity maintains a dedicated atlas of unique communication paths. This prevents resource pooling, as any delay mismatch triggers an audit. Honest agents pay 1x cost, while fakes must pay 1,000x for isolated slots, with immediate identity revocation upon detected relay.
